ranking_by: number of bones in each body region (adult, both sides counted)
subject: human skeleton
title: The 5 Body Parts With the Most Bones, Ranked (Your Skull Is Only #5)

scenes.text: Over half your bones hide in just two places. Your skull isn't one of them.
Number five: your skull. Twenty-two bones, locked together so tightly they look like one.
scenes.label: Skull · 22 bones

scenes.text: Number four: your rib cage. Twenty-four ribs plus your breastbone makes twenty-five.
scenes.label: Rib cage · 25 bones

scenes.text: Number three: your spine. Twenty-six bones, from your neck all the way down to your tailbone.
scenes.label: Spine · 26 bones

scenes.text: Number two: your feet. Twenty-six bones in each one, fifty-two in total.
scenes.label: Both feet · 52 bones

scenes.text: Number one: your hands. Twenty-seven each, fifty-four together. Hands and feet hold more than half your skeleton.
scenes.label: Both hands · 54 bones

description:
Bones per body region in an adult: both hands 54 (27 each), both feet 52 (26 each), spine 26 (24 vertebrae plus sacrum and tailbone), rib cage 25 (24 ribs plus the sternum), skull 22 (8 cranial and 14 facial).
Hands and feet together hold 106 of your 206 bones.
Which number surprised you most?
first_comment: Would you have put the hands at number one? Tell us what part of the body we should rank next.
